scriptToggleItem.label: Auto Version Save
scriptToggleItem.scriptCode:
import hou import saveUp
hou.hscript(""" if( $AUTOSAVE_TOGGLE ) then set -g AUTOSAVE_TOGGLE = 0; else set -g AUTOSAVE_TOGGLE = 1; endif """) hou.hscript('varchange AUTOSAVE_TOGGLE')
#current state (out, err) = hou.hscript('echo $AUTOSAVE_TOGGLE') enabled = int(out.strip()) == 1
#timer callback def auto_version_save(): (out, err) = hou.hscript('echo $AUTOSAVE_TOGGLE') if int(out.strip()) == 1: try: saveUp.saveUp() print("Auto version save completed") except Exception as e: print(f"Auto version save failed: {e}") return 1200.0 #20mn
if enabled: if not hasattr(hou.session, 'auto_version_timer'): hou.session.auto_version_timer = None
#del old timer if exists if hou.session.auto_version_timer is not None: hou.ui.removeEventLoopCallback(hou.session.auto_version_timer)
#add new timer hou.session.auto_version_timer = hou.ui.addEventLoopCallback(auto_version_save) hou.ui.displayMessage("Auto version save enabled (every 20 min)", severity=hou.severityType.Message) else: #stop timer if hasattr(hou.session, 'auto_version_timer') and hou.session.auto_version_timer is not None: hou.ui.removeEventLoopCallback(hou.session.auto_version_timer) hou.session.auto_version_timer = None hou.ui.displayMessage("Auto version save disabled", severity=hou.severityType.Message)
